ENGINE – 2JZ–GE ENGINE TROUBLESHOOTING

6  Check for open and short in harness and connector between ignitioin switch
and ignition coil, ignition coil and igniter (See page IN–30).

OK

NG  Repair or replace harness or connector.

7  Check ignition coil.

Primary Coil

P  Disconnect ignition coil connector.

C  (1) Check primary coil.
Measure resistance between terminals of ignition coil
connector.
(2) Check secondary coil.
Measure resistance between terminal (+) of ignition coil
connector and high–tension terminal.

OK

                              Resistance
(a)  Primary Coil    Cold    0.36 ~ 0.55 Ω
                      Hot     0.45 ~ 0.65 Ω
(b)  Secondary       Cold    9.0 ~ 11.1 kΩ
     Coil             Hot     11.4 ~ 18.1 kΩ

"Cold" is from — 10°C (14°F) to 50°C (122°F) and
"Hot" is from 50°C (122°F) to 100°C (212°F).

Secondary Coil

(+)

P11573

OK

Replace igniter.
